title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Planning and Construction of Hebei Xiong'an New Area
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Planning and Construction of Hebei Xiong'an New Area

Fa Fa [2019] No. 22

In order to thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, to earnestly implement the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core regarding the establishment of Hebei Xiong'an New Area and the in-depth promotion of the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, to fully leverage the functional role of the people's courts, and to serve and guarantee the comprehensive deepening of reforms and expansion of opening up in Hebei Xiong'an New Area, the following opinions are formulated.

I. Effectively Raise Political Standing, Enhance the Sense of Responsibility and Mission for Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Planning and Construction of Xiong'an New Area

1. Deeply understand the great significance of the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area, and clarify that serving and guaranteeing the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area is the glorious mission and sacred duty of the people's courts in the new era. The establishment of Xiong'an New Area is a major historic strategic choice made by the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. It is a millennium plan and a major national event, and has significant and far-reaching implications for promoting the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and building a world-class urban agglomeration centered on the capital. People's courts at all levels must thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, strengthen "Four Consciousnesses," firm up "Four Confidences," achieve "Two Upholds," earnestly implement the new development concept, effectively enhance the consciousness and initiative of work, hear related cases impartially and efficiently according to law, deeply advance judicial system reform, comprehensively deepen the construction of smart courts, and provide powerful judicial services and guarantees for building Xiong'an New Area into a high-level socialist modern city and a national model for high-quality development in the new era.

2. Accurately grasp the development goals of the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area, and identify the entry points and focal points for providing judicial services and guarantees. Currently, Xiong'an New Area has shifted from the stage of mainly formulating plans to the stage of substantive construction. People's courts at all levels must deeply grasp this practical work and provide more scientific, precise, and powerful judicial services and guarantees for comprehensively advancing the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area. They must firmly grasp the requirement of actively, steadily, and orderly relieving Beijing's non-capital functions, strengthen communication and coordination with Party and government organs, adhere to the rule of law thinking, adhere to a problem-oriented approach, focus on judicial issues existing in key areas and critical links such as innovative development, urban construction, and public services, strengthen investigation and research, formulate judicial policies, innovate working mechanisms, fully satisfy the judicial needs of Xiong'an New Area's innovative development, and enhance the capability and level of providing comprehensive judicial services and guarantees for the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area.

II. Fully Leverage Functional Roles, Provide Powerful Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Planning and Construction of Xiong'an New Area

3. Strengthen criminal adjudication to provide a safe and stable social environment for the construction of Xiong'an New Area. Punish all types of criminal offenses affecting the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area according to law, strictly punish criminal cases that interfere with the relief of Beijing's non-capital functions and the construction of key projects, and actively serve the optimization of industrial layout in Xiong'an New Area. Strictly punish economic crimes involving multiple victims, such as illegal absorption of public deposits, fund-raising fraud, and financial fraud, to maintain market order and social order. Increase efforts to punish crimes endangering production safety, promote the implementation of production safety responsibility systems, and ensure the safety of people's lives and property. Strengthen the adjudication of criminal cases involving environmental resources, such as environmental pollution, illegal logging, and illegal mining, and strengthen the judicial protection of environmental resources. Strictly punish crimes of embezzlement, misappropriation, and fraud against state or collective property during expropriation, demolition, and enterprise restructuring according to law. Strictly punish crimes committed by mafia-like and evil forces, with a focus on cracking down on mafia-like and evil-related crimes in areas such as land expropriation, demolition, and engineering construction; strictly punish related duty crimes; resolutely dismantle the protective umbrellas of mafia-like and evil forces; and effectively maintain social stability and the peace of the people in Xiong'an New Area.

4. Strengthen civil and commercial adjudication to serve and guarantee high-quality economic development. Properly adjudicate cases involving contract disputes, property rights disputes, company disputes, guarantee disputes, bankruptcy disputes, and labor disputes related to the relief of non-capital functions, and actively serve the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region. Strengthen the judicial protection of property rights, strictly regulate the disposal of property involved in cases, apply compulsory measures prudently according to law, and provide powerful judicial services and guarantees for creating a development environment with effective incentives for property rights, free flow of factors, fair and orderly competition, and survival of the fittest for enterprises. Legally and properly adjudicate cases involving hidden barriers in the fields of credit, investment, and bidding, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of private enterprises, and create a sound legal environment for the development of micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises in Xiong'an New Area. Adhere to the goal of effectively realizing the population transfer from the relief of Beijing's non-capital functions, strengthen the adjudication of cases in livelihood fields such as education, medical care, culture, social security, and employment and entrepreneurship, and actively serve to guarantee and improve people's livelihoods. Strengthen the adjudication of cases in real estate-related fields, serve the construction of a new housing supply system, actively use judicial means to support relevant departments in strictly controlling surrounding housing prices, preventing speculative activities of flipping houses and land, and provide judicial support for improving diversified land use and supply models such as land transfer, leasing, combination of leasing and transfer, mixed space transfer, and contribution of land as capital shares.

5. Strengthen administrative adjudication to support and supervise administrative organs in exercising their functions according to law. Legally serve and guarantee the innovative management models of administrative organs in Xiong'an New Area, deeply promote the reform of "delegating power, improving regulation, and optimizing services," and support administrative organs in Xiong'an New Area in performing their duties according to law. Strengthen the adjudication of administrative cases in fields such as land development and utilization, urban planning and design, infrastructure construction, and urban management, and strengthen the role of judicial adjudication in serving and guaranteeing the planning and utilization of national land spatial resources. Properly adjudicate administrative cases related to expropriation, demolition, and resettlement, and improve and perfect a land expropriation working mechanism with standardized procedures, reasonable compensation, and diversified guarantees. For administrative litigation arising from the delegation of approvals and administrative licensing matters in engineering construction, market access, and social management by administrative organs to Xiong'an New Area, strengthen adjudication supervision and guidance, and effectively promote innovation in administrative management systems and mechanisms. Establish a green channel for administrative non-litigation enforcement cases, promptly review non-litigation enforcement applications according to law, and ensure the timely advancement of major construction projects.

6. Strengthen intellectual property adjudication to serve innovation-driven development. Strengthen guidance on the adjudication of intellectual property cases in the Xiong'an New Area courts, and support the construction of a fair and efficient judicial protection mechanism for intellectual property in Xiong'an New Area. Guide the in-depth promotion of the "three-in-one" work of intellectual property civil, administrative, and criminal adjudication, and promote the specialization, modernization, and scientific development of the intellectual property adjudication system in Xiong'an New Area. Support the construction of the Intellectual Property Protection Center in Xiong'an New Area, expand the radiation and driving effect of Xiong'an New Area on surrounding areas in intellectual property protection, and continuously improve the level of judicial protection of intellectual property in Xiong'an New Area. Support the cultivation of intellectual property adjudication talents in Xiong'an New Area, promote the establishment of a talent entrusted cultivation and exercise exchange mechanism between Xiong'an New Area and courts in various regions, and focus on cultivating a team of intellectual property judges who are mindful of the overall situation, proficient in law, understand technology, and have an international perspective, to better serve the innovation-driven development of Xiong'an New Area.

7. Strengthen financial adjudication to effectively prevent and resolve major financial risks. Properly adjudicate financial cases involving construction financing for Xiong'an New Area, issuance of local government bonds, and private lending, and properly adjudicate cases involving disputes arising from corporate issuance and listing, mergers and acquisitions, equity transfers, bond issuance, and asset securitization in Xiong'an New Area. Strengthen judicial research on cases involving innovative businesses such as financial asset trading platforms and equity crowdfunding. Support the innovative development of the Xiong'an New Area Management Committee, arbitration institutions, and commercial and industry mediation organizations, strengthen the source governance of disputes, improve the connection between litigation and mediation, and focus on preventing and resolving major risks in the financial field at the source. Strengthen the specialized construction of financial adjudication and establish specialized financial adjudication divisions.

8. Strengthen adjudication involving agriculture to promote the implementation of the rural revitalization strategy in Xiong'an New Area. Actively implement the land management system reform policies and the newly revised Land Administration Law, promote land system reform in Xiong'an New Area, enhance the flexibility of land management, and serve the implementation of reform policies. Properly adjudicate cases involving disputes over farmers' transfer of land contracting rights, qualification rights for homestead land, and contribution of collective asset equity to enterprises or economic organizations arising from the reform of the rural collective property rights system according to law. Increase efforts to punish illegal and criminal acts that damage the legitimate rights and interests of farmers, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of land-expropriated farmers. Leverage the role of people's tribunals in social governance in Xiong'an New Area, and promote the improvement of the grassroots social governance system combining autonomy, rule of law, and rule of virtue.

9. Strengthen environmental resources adjudication to promote the construction of a model green development city. Promote innovation in the judicial system and mechanism for environmental resources, and establish a centralized jurisdiction system for environmental resources cases in Xiong'an New Area and its surrounding areas, and the Baiyangdian Lake Basin. Properly adjudicate disputes over ownership of natural resources according to law, and provide judicial services and guarantees for promoting the establishment of a clear and well-defined property rights system for natural resources with clear powers and responsibilities, and implementing unified registration of natural resources rights. Improve the market-oriented judicial protection mechanism for the ecological environment, deeply study the legal attributes and trading rules of energy use rights, water use rights, emission rights, and carbon emission trading rights, and provide judicial support for building a market-oriented green technology innovation system, and establishing a resource environment pricing mechanism, diversified ecological compensation systems, and a compensation mechanism for ecological relocation in the lake area that conforms to the functional positioning and development reality of Xiong'an New Area.

10. Strengthen foreign-related commercial adjudication to build a new highland for open development. Improve judicial rules for foreign trade, support the introduction of various domestic and international capitals to participate in the construction of Xiong'an New Area, and fully protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors. Strengthen the adjudication of cases related to developing new business forms and models in trade, conducting pilot projects for innovative development of service trade, and establishing comprehensive pilot zones for cross-border e-commerce. Improve the adjudication of cases involving internet finance, and serve the construction of a digital trade platform oriented globally. Strengthen the adjudication of foreign-related financial cases, support the establishment of wholly foreign-owned or sino-foreign joint venture financial institutions in Xiong'an New Area, establish a judicial rule system that aligns with the general rules of international investment and trade, and build a fair competition system. Support the establishment of authoritative international arbitration, certification, and appraisal institutions in Xiong'an New Area, and explore the establishment of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for commercial disputes.

11. Strengthen enforcement work to promote the construction of an enforcement coordination and linkage mechanism. Promote the establishment of a large-scale work pattern for comprehensive governance of enforcement difficulties under the leadership of the Party committee, coordination of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee, supervision of the People's Congress, support of the government, leadership of the court, departmental linkage, and social participation, and build a departmental coordination and linkage mechanism for enforcement work in Xiong'an New Area. Increase enforcement efforts in cases involving key projects, prioritize case filing and enforcement, and ensure the timely realization of the rights and interests of the prevailing parties. Support the improvement of the social credit system and commercial integrity system in Xiong'an New Area, explore the establishment of integrity accounts covering all institutions and individuals, implement credit risk classification supervision, establish and improve a wide-ranging joint incentive mechanism for trustworthiness and joint punishment mechanism for dishonesty, achieve automatic comparison, automatic supervision, and automatic punishment of the list information of judgment debtors, and promote the improvement of a credit supervision, warning, and punishment system where "one dishonesty leads to restrictions everywhere."

III. Adhere to Reform and Innovation, Establish and Improve the Judicial Work System and Mechanism Adapted to the Coordinated Development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region

12. Deepen the comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system and strengthen the construction of courts in Xiong'an New Area. The Supreme People's Court strengthens guidance on the judicial system reform of the courts in Xiong'an New Area, adheres to the principle of combining top-level design with local exploration, actively explores and promotes new mechanisms and measures in the judicial field, and supports forward-looking judicial innovation pilot and demonstration projects to be piloted first in Xiong'an New Area. Support the new area courts in actively exploring judicial system reforms adapted to administrative system reforms in light of the planning and construction needs of Xiong'an New Area. Support the new area courts in comprehensively advancing the reform of internal institutions and the construction of adjudication and enforcement organizations according to the principle of optimization, synergy, and efficiency, adjusting and optimizing the layout structure of special political and legal staffing in the new area courts, and establishing a combination of normalized and flexible mechanisms for selecting judges. Explore a merit-based recruitment system suitable for the development needs of the two-level courts in Xiong'an New Area, and give appropriate policy preference to the selection, confirmation, and promotion of judges in the new area courts. Support the courts in Xiong'an New Area in comprehensively building a one-stop diversified dispute resolution mechanism and a one-stop litigation service center, constructing a modern litigation service system that is intensive and efficient, diversified in dispute resolution, convenient for the people, smart and precise, open and interactive, integrated and shared, promoting the innovation of dispute resolution and litigation service concepts and mechanisms, and effectively improving the ability and level of the people's courts to resolve conflicts and disputes and serve the people.

13. Comprehensively deepen the construction of smart courts to enhance the informatization level of judicial service guarantees. Support the courts in Xiong'an New Area in actively adapting to the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area and the judicial needs of the people, taking the initiative to go one step ahead in comprehensively deepening the construction of smart courts, laying out intelligent infrastructure with a moderate forward-looking approach, accelerating the improvement of the configuration level of information infrastructure, the performance of court-specific networks, and network security defense capabilities, promoting the deep integration of technological innovations such as big data, artificial intelligence, and 5G with judicial work, promoting the modernization of the adjudication system and adjudication capacity, and matching the judicial service guarantee capability with the requirement of creating a digital smart city in Xiong'an New Area. Support the courts in Xiong'an New Area in fully utilizing the first-mover advantages of informatization application in the new area, expanding the coverage scope, application proportion, and application level of electronic litigation, and strengthening the construction and application of enforcement informatization. Establish and improve the mechanism for the synchronous generation and in-depth application of electronic case files alongside cases, and comprehensively promote the intelligent application of adjudication. Improve the level of informatization application in areas such as litigation service information inquiry, reception and handling of petitions, rapid case filing processing, and online mediation, and promote the enhancement of the people's sense of gain.

14. Promote the construction of a mechanism for the unified application of law, and establish and improve a mechanism for the unified adjudication standards of cases. Improve the case communication mechanism, strengthen the research, summary, and refinement of common and cutting-edge legal issues and adjudication rules for typical cases within the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and promptly communicate issues that are universally applicable and have reached consensus to courts at all levels in the region. Explore the establishment of guidelines for the adjudication of typical cases covering various business fields such as criminal and civil matters, establish a long-term mechanism for business discussion and exchange, actively carry out thematic business discussions and subject research, and promote the unification of legal application.

15. Deepen regional judicial exchanges and cooperation, and strengthen comprehensive coordination and cooperation among courts in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region. Improve the joint meeting mechanism of courts in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, strengthen overall coordination, supervision, and inspection, strengthen the research, judgment, and support for major judicial matters, judicial needs, judicial policies, and major difficult legal application issues in the development of the new area, promote the sharing of platforms, information, resources, and business collaboration across the various stages of case filing, adjudication, and enforcement, achieve cross-regional remote processing and cross-level linked handling of litigation matters, and effectively solve difficulties such as difficulty in filing cases in different places. Courts in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region shall, according to their division of duties, form a joint work force, introduce judicial policies and measures that match and adapt to the development of Xiong'an New Area, and better leverage the functional role of the people's courts in serving and guaranteeing the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area.

16. Strengthen support for the construction and development of courts in Xiong'an New Area. Strengthen guidance on adjudication business and material guarantees for the courts in Xiong'an New Area, establish and improve cooperation mechanisms between the new area courts and courts in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, the Pearl River Delta, and other regions in terms of talent cultivation, intellectual support, and informatization construction. Encourage courts in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region to select and send business experts in relevant fields to serve temporary posts in the courts of Xiong'an New Area, achieving the intercommunication and integration of personnel resources, and providing guarantees for the new area courts to better perform their duties. Support the courts in Xiong'an New Area in constructing a more open mechanism for talent cultivation, introduction, and exchange, actively explore reforming the mechanism for talent cultivation and reserve, and focus on cultivating high-level adjudication talents with an international perspective, knowledge of international rules, and proficiency in foreign languages. Support the courts in Xiong'an New Area in strengthening international judicial exchanges and cooperation, and build the courts in Xiong'an New Area into first-class courts with international influence that match the international positioning of Xiong'an New Area.

People's courts at all levels must effectively unify their thoughts and actions to the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee regarding the establishment of Xiong'an New Area and the in-depth promotion of the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, earnestly implement the requirements of this opinion, clarify the objectives and tasks, firmly grasp the implementation of work, closely focus on the work goal of "ensuring that the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," adhere to serving the overall situation, serving the people, and impartial justice, faithfully fulfill the duties endowed by the Constitution and laws, strive to create a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable legalized business environment, and provide more powerful judicial services and guarantees for the planning and construction of Xiong'an New Area.

September 26, 2019
